register.labelZh: COUNT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: count somebody in、count somebody out 和 count somebody among a group 能幫助你清楚說明誰被包括在內。；count towards 表示某事計入總數或結果;count against 則表示某事帶來不利影響。；count on 和 count upon 能表示你依靠某人、某事物,或指望某個行動發生。；count down、count off、count up 和 count out 可以描述倒數、依次報數、點算總數,以及逐一點出指定數量。
register.summaryEn: Count somebody in, count somebody out and count somebody among a group help you say exactly who is included. Count towards shows that something helps to form a total or result, while count against shows that something causes a disadvantage. Count on and count upon help you say that you depend on a person, thing or expected action. Count down, count off, count up and count out describe different ways of saying, adding or separating numbers and items.
